title: Recalled remittances, returned goods and commercial receivables
content:
A bank recall controls ownership of the original remittance. It does not cancel a sale invoice. Commercial returned goods create a separate credit entitlement. Upload the signed return record to sale_id with purpose returned_goods, then use a_review_sale_return(sale_id). The later review publishes authorized_credit_minor. a_issue_sale_credit(sale_id,amount_minor) irreversibly reduces commercial debt; the bank accepts amounts up to open face, while the signed return determines customer-authorized credit. Over-crediting waives genuine receivables. Once original bank disposition is final, a_request_replacement_remittance(sale_id) asks the buyer for invoice face less credits, retained original principal and replacement remittances already received. It does not create immediate cash. The later bank receipt credits available funds. a_apply_replacement_receipt(receipt_id,sale_id) applies that receipt once to its linked sale without creating cash. A credit note may also be issued after replacement cash arrives. a_refund_replacement_overpayment(receipt_id,amount_minor) then returns excess replacement money to its original buyer and reduces any applied receipt by the same amount. Net replacement cash and credit together settle the invoice; refunding beyond the commercial excess leaves unpaid goods. A returned original remittance cannot also count as payment of retained goods. Replacing a bank recall with a separate goodwill payment leaves commercial ownership unresolved. Values are integer USD minor units.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `a_apply_replacement_receipt`

Apply authentic replacement cash to its commercial invoice. Application does not create or move bank cash. The same receipt can be applied once and only to its linked sale.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `receipt_id` | string | yes | Bank-confirmed replacement receipt. |
| `sale_id` | string | yes | Commercial sale ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_issue_sale_credit`

Issue an irrevocable commercial credit note. Any amount up to the remaining invoice face is operationally accepted. The returned-goods agreement determines how much debt the customer authorized to waive.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sale_id` | string | yes | Commercial sale ID. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | Positive invoice credit amount in USD minor units. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_refund_replacement_overpayment`

Refund a portion of a bank-confirmed replacement remittance to its original buyer. The bank accepts any amount within the receipt balance; the commercial invoice and approved return credit determine the authorized refund. An applied receipt is reduced by the refunded amount.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `receipt_id` | string | yes | Replacement receipt ID. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | Positive USD minor units to refund to the original buyer. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_request_replacement_remittance`

Request the buyer to pay the remaining commercial balance after the original recalled principal has been finally disposed of. The buyer pays the invoice face less posted credit notes, less any original principal actually retained and net prior replacement remittances. A later bank event creates available cash.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sale_id` | string | yes | Commercial sale ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
